enriched.summary: A aula aborda a prática de construções gramaticais no inglês, como o uso de tempos verbais no passado, presente e futuro, além de vocabulário rico e útil para situações cotidianas. Exemplos contextualizados e traduções facilitam o aprendizado e a aplicação prática.
mainTopics: Uso de conectores temporais como 'while' e 'when'

vocabulary.definition: To say no to a proposal, request, or offer.
examples: The stand-up comedian refused the one-million-dollar offer to participate in a festival in the Middle East.

vocabulary.definition: To move forward or develop in a positive direction.
examples: Medicine will progress much faster with the help of AI especially in the treatment of cancer.

vocabulary.definition: The process of creating a plan to spend money.
examples: Was your department doing the budgeting for next year when the Director left the company?

vocabulary.definition: To leave one's job and stop working, usually because of age.
examples: What are you going to do when you retire?

vocabulary.definition: Medical care given to a patient for an illness or injury.
examples: Medicine will progress much faster with the help of AI especially in the treatment of cancer.

vocabulary.definition: To leave, especially in relation to travel.
To establish a colony in a new area.

grammar.explanation: Used to describe actions or events that happened and were completed in the past.
rules: Add '-ed' to the base form of regular verbs.
For irregular verbs, use the specific past form (e.g., 'go' becomes 'went').
examples: He met his wife when he was working in Japan.
I met Tom and Jane at the airport some weeks ago.
commonMistakes: Using the base form instead of the past form: 'He meet his wife' (incorrect).
Confusing irregular verb forms: 'He meeted his wife' (incorrect).

grammar.explanation: Used to describe actions that were in progress at a specific point in the past.
rules: Often used with another past action to show interruption.
examples: While I was doing shopping for Christmas, I also bought some things for me.
We talked while we were waiting for our flights.
commonMistakes: Using the wrong auxiliary verb: 'I am doing shopping' (incorrect in past context).

grammar.explanation: 'Will' is used for decisions made at the moment of speaking and predictions, while 'going to' is used for planned actions and evidence-based predictions.
rules: Use 'will' + base form for spontaneous decisions or predictions.
Use 'be going to' + base form for plans or intentions.
examples: Tom is going to be late for work because he left home late.
commonMistakes: Confusing 'will' and 'going to': 'I will going to the store' (incorrect).
Omitting 'to be' with 'going to': 'I going to the store' (incorrect).

expressions.usage: Used to ask or talk about enjoyment during an activity.
examples: Did you have fun / have a good time in Vancouver?

practiceQuestions.question: Complete the sentence: While I was __________ for Christmas, I also bought some things for me.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The Past Continuous is used to describe an action in progress in the past.

practiceQuestions.question: Translate: 'O que você vai fazer quando aposentar-se?'
practiceQuestions.answer: What are you going to do when you retire?
practiceQuestions.explanation: The sentence asks about a planned action in the future, so 'going to' is appropriate.

culturalNotes: Stand-up comedy is a popular form of entertainment in English-speaking countries, often involving humor about everyday life.
The use of AI in medicine is a growing trend in many developed countries, particularly in cancer research.
studyTips: Practice conjugating irregular verbs daily to reinforce their forms.
Use flashcards to memorize vocabulary and their translations.
Write your own sentences using the grammar points and vocabulary from this lesson.
originalExamples: The stand-up comedian refused the one-million-dollar offer to participate in a festival in the Middle East. (O comediante de stand-up recusou a oferta de um milhão de dólares para participar de um festival no Oriente Médio.)
Trump promised he will put an end to the war in Ukraine. (Trump prometeu que ele acabará com a guerra na Ucrânia.)
Medicine will progress much faster with the help of AI especially in the treatment of cancer. (A medicina progredirá mais rapidamente com a ajuda da IA, especialmente no tratamento do câncer.)
While I was doing shopping for Christmas, I also bought some things for me. (Enquanto eu estava fazendo compras para o Natal, eu também comprei algumas coisas para mim.)
Was your department doing the budgeting for next year when the Director left the company? (Seu departamento estava fazendo o orçamento do próximo ano quando o Diretor deixou a empresa?)
He met his wife when he was working in Japan. (Ele conheceu sua esposa quando ele estava trabalhando no Japão.)
Did you have fun / have a good time in Vancouver? (Vocês se divertiram em Vancouver?)
Was she wearing a coat when she left? (Ela estava usando um casaco quando ela saiu?)
When will we colonize Mars? (Quando colonizaremos Marte?)
What are you going to do when you retire? (O que você vai fazer quando aposentar-se?)
